lines.t: I can fill my mind with passing hunger
Try to live on lesser things
Still be moving, still be breathing
While my spirit starts to fade
What I welcome into thinking
Either dulls or gives me sight
What I fill myself with daily
Decides if I’m full or hollow
I can walk by my own desire
Or walk by what is true
I can chase what never fills me
Or stay alive in You
As life without Your Spirit
Is just motion, not a flame
I don’t want to just be breathing
You’re what keeps my heart awake
Faith grows dim when left unattended
Like a fire without its air
But when I feed on what You’ve spoken
Life begins to meet me there
Daily bread, not passing pleasure
Heaven’s words become my portion
When I turn myself away
I don’t want a life that’s only motion
I don’t want a heart half-awake
I remember who I am without You
And I remember what’s at stake
Everything I try to live on
Leaves me wanting something more
So I keep my mind stayed higher
On the things worth living for
I’ve seen what living looks like empty
I’ve felt the weight of hollow days
But when I walk within Your Spirit
Everything begins to change
My eyes grow clear, my heart grows open
Faith finds room enough to grow
Life is more than just the motion
It’s staying where Your Spirit flows
I can walk by my own desire
Or walk by what is true
I can chase what never fills me
Or stay alive in You
Because life without Your Spirit
Is just motion, not a flame
I don’t want to just be breathing
You’re what keeps my heart awake
Not just moving.
Not just breathing.
I want a heart awake.
